requirement.description: Missing import for AnycastIpList class in cloudfront module. Tests fail with ImportError when trying to import AnycastIpList from troposphere.cloudfront.
requirement.contract: Ensure that AnycastIpList class is properly defined and exported in the cloudfront module so it can be imported by tests.

requirement.description: Incorrect validation logic in validate_dbinstance function. The validation for gp3 storage performance ratios doesn't properly handle Ref objects, causing TypeError when AllocatedStorage is a Ref.
requirement.contract: Modify the validation logic in validate_dbinstance to properly handle AWSHelperFn objects (like Ref) when checking gp3 storage performance ratios. The function should not attempt to convert Ref objects to integers.

requirement.description: Parameter validation logic incorrectly rejects AllowedPattern for String type parameters when it should be allowed. The validation should permit AllowedPattern on String type parameters.
requirement.contract: Fix the parameter validation logic to allow AllowedPattern property for String type parameters, as per AWS CloudFormation specification.

requirement.description: Template equality comparison issue. The __eq__ method in Template class compares dictionaries directly, but fails to account for the correct handling of TypeComparator objects.
requirement.contract: Improve the Template.__eq__ method to properly handle comparisons with TypeComparator objects and ensure accurate equality checks.

requirement.description: BaseAWSObject equality comparison issue. The __eq__ method in BaseAWSObject class fails to properly handle comparisons with TypeComparator objects in some cases.
requirement.contract: Improve the BaseAWSObject.__eq__ method to properly handle TypeComparator objects and ensure correct equality checks.
